title: Gaming Obsidian
description: Improves obsidian visibility with a bright, color-shifting rainbow design. Perfect for easily spotting obsidian blocks in any environment.
body:
# Gaming Obsidian - Automated Disaster Prevention (and a bit of a meme)

Let’s be honest. There are two exact reasons why this resource pack exists:
1. To save your complex World Eaters and flying machines from explosive disasters caused by a single, hidden piece of obsidian.
2. Because ordinary obsidian is boring, and making it a fabulous, glowing rainbow block is just inherently funny.

Whether you are a hardcore technical Minecraft player prepping a massive perimeter or just someone who wants their world to look a little more ridiculous, Rainbow Obsidian has got you covered!

## Key Features

- Anti-World-Eater Utility: An unmined obsidian block can completely destroy hours of wiring and flying machines. This pack turns obsidian into a glowing beacon, allowing you to easily spot and manually clear it before turning on your quarry machinery.
- Aggressive Visibility: No more "pixel hunting" in pitch-black Deepslate layers or fluid-filled ravines. The vibrant rainbow design slices through the darkness, making it impossible to miss.
- Embrace the Meme: Why use a boring dark block when you can turn your Nether portals and perimeter hazards into a literal rave party? 
- 100% Lightweight: This pack changes ONLY the standard Obsidian block. It is extremely lightweight, FPS-friendly, and leaves every other block in your game completely untouched.
